messages:
Marta: Quick check — ran into a weird combo of poetry + pip-installed deps when testing the Python SDK in our example app. Poetry lock gives aiohttp 3.8.5 but CI pip install pulls 3.9.x and streaming chunks break. Anyone seen this?
Jake: Which streaming path — server-sent events or the SDK chunked HTTP streaming?
Marta: Chunked HTTP from the SDK (the streaming chat API). Client hangs after first yield. Locally `poetry run` works, CI `pip install -r requirements.txt` fails.
Sanjay: Sounds like an aiohttp API change. 3.9 bumped some internals. Try pinning to 3.8.* in pyproject, or use the SDK's extra `redwood[async]` which pins compatible versions.
Marta: I tried pinning but mypy then complains about `ClientResponse` type changes. Type hints are drifting between versions. Any tips to keep stubs stable?
Liz: We had that earlier — add `types-aiohttp` in dev-dependencies and set `python -m pip install aiohttp==3.8.5 types-aiohttp==3.8.1` in CI. Also enable `--ignore-missing-imports` for third-party C extensions in mypy config if needed.
Jake: Another option: switch CI to use `poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes` so the exact locked deps are installed by pip. That keeps env parity with `poetry run`.
Marta: Good call. I can update the CI job. Any concern about lockfile drift for external contributors using pip?
Sanjay: Add a quick note in CONTRIBUTING.md: prefer `poetry install` for dev and CI should use exported requirements for building wheels/tests. Keep both options but document fallback.
Marta: Also seeing auth hiccups when streaming — token refresh mid-stream returns 401 and SDK doesn't retry. Is that expected?
Liz: SDK will retry idempotent calls, but streams are tricky. We should implement a reconnect + resume logic on the client side for streaming. There's an open issue to surface a callback hook for token refresh.
Marta: PR incoming to add `on_auth_refresh` hook in the async client so callers can reattach credentials without dropping higher-level state. Will post link.
ci-bot: build #421 passed for branch feature/py-poetry-ci-fix (:tada:)
Jake: Nice. When you open the PR, add a short changelog note about type-hint compatibility and example for `poetry export`. Also include a small test that simulates token expiry mid-stream.
Marta: Will do. ETA EOD to update CI + tests. If anyone wants to pair on the mypy bits LMK.
Liz: I can help with mypy — have a local config that works across 3.8/3.9 stubs.
Sanjay: Thanks — after this we should add a short doc to devex about common Python pitfalls: poetry vs pip, types for third-party libs, async streaming caveats.
Marta: Agree. I'll jot a short checklist and drop it in /docs and link from SDK README. Thanks all :+1:
